scene.text: Open Matchup Dashboard | Coach navigation / Matchup link | Approved coaches open the dashboard. Sign-in and role checks | protect the page and API. Season and team choices load first; an | unavailable list has its own retry. |

Choose the matchup | Season | Our team | Opponent | Minimum possessions | Choose different teams and a supported season. Valid filter changes | automatically load both comparisons. Switching Usage and Defense | needs no new request. | Filters apply automatically |

Loading current inputs | Current filters stay visible | Old results disappear immediately when inputs change. Only the | latest matching response is accepted. Requests time out after sixty | seconds with a retry option. | Loading current comparisons… |

Usage and Efficiency | Usage view | Scatter chart | Accessible table | Compare usage and PPP with the same play type across the league. | Zero lines show more or less frequent and above or below league. | All eleven available rows stay visible. |

Opponent Defense | Defense view | Bar chart | Accessible table | Compare the opponent allowed PPP with the same-play-type league | rate. Highlight up to three positive differences with enough | possessions. Four unsupported categories say Unavailable. |

Low sample support | Minimum possessions | Sample labels | Keep all available rows visible. Mark low samples and exclude them | from defensive highlights. Changing the threshold starts a fresh | request without hiding rows. | Threshold change returns to Loading |

No above-league callout | Defense table remains available | If no eligible positive difference exists, show no above-league | callout. If a view has no rows, show no data. Changing the matchup | returns to Loading. | Change any matchup filter |

Unavailable or retry | Error message | Retry | Current filters | Access, input, unavailable-data and timeout errors show a clear | message. Try again returns to Loading using current filters. | Historical comparisons are not forecasts. |
